# IOriginETHVault
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/origin/IOriginETHVault.sol)

**Title:**
IOriginETHVault

Interface for the Origin ETH vault, handling minting and queued withdrawals of OETH


## Functions
### withdrawalRequests

Returns the details of a withdrawal request


```solidity
function withdrawalRequests(uint256 requestId) external view returns (WithdrawalRequest memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestId`|`uint256`|The index of the withdrawal request|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`WithdrawalRequest`|The withdrawal request data|


### mint

Mints OETH by depositing the underlying asset


```solidity
function mint(address to, uint256 amount, uint256 minShares) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`to`|`address`|The address of the asset deposited to mint OETH|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of the asset to deposit|
|`minShares`|`uint256`|The minimum amount of OETH to mint (slippage protection)|


### requestWithdrawal

Requests a withdrawal, queueing it for later claim


```solidity
function requestWithdrawal(uint256 amount) external returns (uint256 requestId, uint256 queued);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of OETH to redeem|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestId`|`uint256`|The index of the created withdrawal request|
|`queued`|`uint256`|The cumulative queued amount for this request|


### claimWithdrawal

Claims a single previously requested withdrawal


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal(uint256 _requestId) external returns (uint256 amount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_requestId`|`uint256`|The index of the withdrawal request to claim|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets claimed|


### claimWithdrawals

Claims multiple previously requested withdrawals


```solidity
function claimWithdrawals(uint256[] calldata _requestIds)
    external
    returns (uint256[] memory amounts, uint256 totalAmount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_requestIds`|`uint256[]`|The indexes of the withdrawal requests to claim|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts claimed for each request|
|`totalAmount`|`uint256`|The total amount claimed across all requests|


## Structs
### WithdrawalRequest
A queued withdrawal request awaiting claim


```solidity
struct WithdrawalRequest {
    address withdrawer;
    bool claimed;
    uint40 timestamp; // timestamp of the withdrawal request
    // Amount of oTokens to redeem. eg OETH
    uint128 amount;
    // cumulative total of all withdrawal requests including this one.
    // this request can be claimed when this queued amount is less than or equal to the queue's claimable amount.
    uint128 queued;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`withdrawer`|`address`|The address that requested the withdrawal|
|`claimed`|`bool`|Whether the request has already been claimed|
|`timestamp`|`uint40`|The timestamp of the withdrawal request|
|`amount`|`uint128`|The amount of oTokens to redeem (e.g. OETH)|
|`queued`|`uint128`|The cumulative total of all withdrawal requests including this one; claimable once the queue's claimable amount reaches this value|
